candidates.term: The Sage inside the Partner Gate
candidates.defline: Care sits in your spouse palace: home, for you, must be a harbor before it is anything else.
candidates.reading: This position rules Love and Family, and it tends Health. You partner for peace: a home that restores, a person who is also a resting place, love expressed as looking after. You will likely marry someone who needs your shelter or supplies it, so watch the balance. Mothers and in-laws stand close to this palace, so set the doors early. At its best, this is the marriage people recover inside. Keep a little weather in it anyway. Harbors still need tides.
